items.title: The 10,000 treasures of the Marquis’ tomb
items.description: A staggering haul of more than 10,000 treasures have been unearthed from an ancient royal tomb in Jiangxi province. Some of the amazing artefacts discovered during the five-year excavation are now on show at the Capital Museum in Beijing. The tomb, near modern day Nanchang, is the last resting place of Liu He, who was emperor for just 27 days before being overthrown for his “lack of talent and morals”. items.description: These photographs taken by Meng Han highlight Chinese children who have been adopted by American families, lading new lives in the USA. items.title: IN PHOTOS: Tsunami barrier in Japan's northeastern coast
items.description: Four years after much of Japan's northeastern coast was devastated by a tsunami, a chain of cement sea walls stretching nearly 400km is under construction. items.title: A perfect stunt: Two Russian daredevils climb world’s second tallest building
items.description:
A video filmed using head mounted cameras of two gutsy Russians scaling China's Shanghai Tower without ropes or any climbing gear has gone viral.
Vadim Makhorov and Vitaliy Raskalov not only climbed to the top of the Shanghai Tower, but also scaled a crane on top of the building. The pair sneaked into the building site at midnight on Chinese New Year and spent almost two hours climbing up 120 floors to reach a height of 650 metres.
All photos by Imagine China.
